description: Home office deduction: simplified ($5/sq ft, up to 300 sq ft) vs regular Form 8829 method, with the business income limit and carryovers. Give home_sqft and costs to compare both.

basis.description: Home basis for depreciation (building only, not land)

first_month.description: Month the office was first used (1-12) if this is the first year

gross_income.description: Gross income from the business use of the home

home_sqft.description: Whole home area in sq ft

mortgage_interest.description: Home mortgage interest for the year

office_sqft.description: Office area in sq ft (regular and exclusive business use)

other_expenses.description: Other business expenses not tied to the home

prior_operating.description: Carryover of operating costs from last year

name: home_office
title: Home office deduction
